text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened while Tamamo Cross was doing her pre-training warm-ups.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What the... My legs aren't moving
forward the way I want 'em to..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Nah, I can't let myself get discouraged over something like this.
Everyone else is workin' just as hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna win race after race, get real famous,
and make life easy for my whole family...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might still have some lingering fatigue from the race.
It looks like we'll need to review her upcoming race schedule.
